target_customer: Enterprise marketing and compliance teams that run advertising in-house
problem: Enterprises spend heavily on advertising and need each ad checked against brand and legal rules, which is slow and manual.
product_category: AI marketing agents and ad compliance

founders.name: Rohan Mahendraker
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a self-taught software engineer who built and sold compliance software to Fortune 500 companies. No education listed.

founders.name: Anton Muratov
founders.background_notes: YC page states he closed seven-figure deals with the largest US bank and advised Fortune 500 firms on regulatory policy.

competitors.name: MAI
competitors.what: AI agents that manage and optimize ad campaigns, mainly Google Ads

competitors.name: AdsGency
competitors.what: Agentic ad agency covering strategy, creative, placement and optimization
competitors.funding_then: $12M seed led by XYZ Venture Capital

competitors.name: Kana
competitors.what: Autonomous marketing agents for campaign optimization across platforms

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent workflows over ad platform APIs and compliance rule checks are mostly integration work on top of foundation models, with enterprise security certifications the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Enterprise integrations and certifications add friction, but better funded agent startups and the platforms themselves offer similar automation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google announced Marketing Advisor in May 2025 and Amazon showed ad agents in 2025; no outcome for Veriad yet.

market_need_then: The company cites about $1T yearly ad spend and $100B wasted on non-compliant or ineffective ads (its own claim). Funded competitors in 2025 show investor demand for ad agents.

branding.domain_note: Uses veriad.com; a prior company named Veriad (Moore Corp unit, 2000) held a now dead trademark.

identity.visual_style: Clean modern, channel logos and product imagery
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident benefit-led, sentence case, plain language

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; the name resembles the older Veriad and similar names like Veriato.

outcome_analysis: Veriad is an active Winter 2026 company with two founders, no reported exit and no confirmed funding beyond a single aggregator listing. The story is too early to classify; the main risk is that well funded ad agent startups and the ad platforms already offer end to end automation.
notes: VCBacked reports $500K pre-seed in March 2026 with Y Combinator as the only investor; Crunchbase shows pre-seed stage without amount. Single aggregator, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Location conflict: YC page says London, VCBacked says San Francisco. YC page says founded 2025. Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (VCBacked); no press confirmation found in a second search. Total raised may be larger.
